Tolv frågor över hela kursen. Förklaring: Twelve questions from the whole course. The explanation appears right after each answer.
1. Vilken ordning stämmer för ett forwar: 1. Which order is correct for a forward pass?
Text → ids → vektorer → 32 lager → logit: Text → ids → vectors → 32 layers → logits → new token.
2. Vilken tensor har shape [32, T, T] vi: 2. Which tensor has shape [32, T, T] during prefill in Llama-3-8B?
One T × T matrix per query head.
3. ”Kan man se vilka vikter som aktivera: 3. “Can you see which weights a question activates?” What is the best answer for a dense model?
Vikterna är programmet, aktiveringarna ä: The weights are the program, the activations are the state. In MoE models, on the other hand, you can see which experts were chosen.
4. Vad händer med KV-cachen när en ny to: 4. What happens to the KV cache when a new token is generated?
En rad K och en rad V per KV head och la: One row of K and one row of V per KV head and layer.
5. Vilket är störst för Llama-3-8B i bf1: 5. Which is largest for Llama-3-8B in bf16?
128 000 · 128 KiB ≈ 16 GB, och vikterna: 128,000 · 128 KiB ≈ 16 GB, and the weights are ≈ 16 GB.
6. GPU:n visar låg beräkningsbelastning: 6. The GPU shows low compute load while a single sequence decodes. Why?
Lösningen är fler sekvenser per steg, in: The fix is more sequences per step, not a faster GPU core.
7. Varför räknar vLLM bara logits för si: 7. Why does vLLM compute logits only for the last position in each sequence?
Vid träning behövs alla positioner. Vid: Training needs every position. Generation needs only the last one.
8. Två requests delar en systemprompt på: 8. Two requests share a 2,000-token system prompt. What does prefix caching save for the second one?
125 fulla block återanvänds. Bara resten: 125 full blocks are reused. Only the rest of the prompt is prefilled.
9. Vilket påstående om MoE stämmer?: 9. Which statement about MoE is correct?
Minne enligt totalen, beräkning enligt d: Memory by the total, compute by the active ones. MoE replaces the MLP, not attention.
10. Varför ger speculative decoding en v: 10. Why does speculative decoding pay off?
Decode är memory-bound, så några extra r: Decode is memory-bound, so a few extra rows in the same pass are almost free.
11. Vad innebär TP = 2 för en modell med: 11. What does TP = 2 mean for a model with 8 KV heads?
Lager på olika GPU:er är pipeline parall: Layers on different GPUs means pipeline parallelism. Full copies means data parallelism.
12. Vad ändras i modellen vid en riktad: 12. What changes in the model with a targeted ablation baked into the weights?
Därför kan en sådan modell köras i vLLM: That is why such a model runs in vLLM without any changes.
Åtta påståenden som låter rimliga. Funde: Eight statements that sound reasonable. Think about what is wrong before you open them.
I en tät modell används alla vikter för: In a dense model every weight is used for every token. What varies is the activations. Only in MoE are parts of the weights selected, and then per token and layer, not per question.
Vikterna ändras aldrig av att du chattar: Chatting never changes the weights. The whole conversation is sent in again every time. The KV cache and prefix caching only mean it does not have to be recomputed.
Den är exakt. Causal mask garanterar att: It is exact. The causal mask guarantees that the K and V of older positions are not affected by new tokens.
Greedy tar bort slumpen i samplingen, me: Greedy removes the randomness in sampling, but floating-point ordering can differ between batches and flip a close argmax.
Uppdelningen lärs in och blir mest synta: The split is learned and ends up mostly syntactic. No expert is “biology”. Each layer also has its own experts.
Samma transformer. Den är tränad att skr: The same transformer. It is trained to write out a reasoning chain first, which costs more decode steps.
Decode är memory-bound. Vikterna läses e: Decode is memory-bound. The weights are read once per step regardless of batch, so throughput grows almost linearly for a good while.
